shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' | head -50 && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "yet-another-react-lightbox Zoom plugin supports custom slide types maxZoom" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/plugins/zoom/ZoomWrapper.tsx; sed -n '1,140p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts; sed -n '1,150p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts; sed -n '1,90p' src/plugins/zoom/props.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json; sed -n '1,120p' src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomProps.ts; rg -n \"useZoomImageRect|ZoomWrapper|resolveZoomProps\" test src"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 && git diff --check && git diff -- src/plugins/zoom'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/plugins/zoom/index.ts src/plugins/zoom/props.ts src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --jsx react-jsx --skipLibCheck src/plugins/zoom/index.ts src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomWrapper.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomController.tsx src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts src/plugins/zoom/props.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --jsx react-jsx --skipLibCheck src/plugins/zoom/index.ts src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomWrapper.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomController.tsx src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts src/plugins/zoom/props.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2020 --jsx react-jsx --skipLibCheck src/plugins/zoom/index.ts src/plugins/zoom/Zoom.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomWrapper.tsx src/plugins/zoom/ZoomController.tsx src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomImageRect.ts src/plugins/zoom/hooks/useZoomState.ts src/plugins/zoom/props.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/zoom-custom-slide-bounds.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Zoom custom content uses displayed bounds

When a zoom interaction wrapper is extended from intrinsic-size content to arbitrary rendered slides, the custom content should use the current displayed slide rectangle as its zoomable bounds. Its maximum zoom must be resolved independently from image pixel-resolution logic, with a stable default and an optional per-slide resolver.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
